firstCall.method: A fresh process per observation, alternating builds; complete results compared on every trial.

isolatedRechecks.note: Scenarios below 0.97x in the full runs, re-measured alone. Generation re-checks ran utc.mjs with 11 samples in both role orientations; the query re-check ran five alternating processes per build.
